這一帶是受保護的自然保護區。

受保護的物種不得獵捕。
The machine dispenses hot drinks for one dollar.
這台機器供應一美元的熱飲。
Pharmacists dispense medicine to patients.
藥師將藥品發給病患。
Volunteers dispensed free water to the runners.
志工免費發水給跑者。
The school dispensed with the usual exam this year.
學校今年免去了平常的考試。
Let's dispense with the formalities and get started.
我們省去那些繁文縟節，直接開始吧。
The teacher said racist jokes are never acceptable.
老師說種族歧視的笑話絕對不能接受。
The company apologized for the racist remark in its ad.
公司為廣告中帶有種族歧視的言論道歉。
He refused to be called a racist and promised to learn more.
他不願被說成是種族歧視者，並承諾要多學習。
No one wants to work with a racist.
沒有人想跟種族歧視者共事。
The room was oddly quiet this morning.
今天早上房間裡安靜得很奇怪。
He behaved oddly during the whole meeting.
他整場會議的舉止都很怪異。
The shepherd led his sheep up the hill.
牧羊人帶著羊群上山。
A shepherd stays with the flock all day.
牧羊人整天都跟著羊群。
The guide shepherded the tourists through the busy market.
導遊帶領遊客穿過熱鬧的市場。
Teachers shepherded the children onto the bus.
老師們引導孩子們上了公車。

raised.zh: 舉起、提高（過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She raised her hand to ask a question.
她舉手發問。
The store raised its prices last month.
這家店上個月調漲了價格。
He was raised by his grandparents in a small village.
他是由祖父母在一個小村子裡養大的。
She raised three children on her own.
她獨自養大了三個孩子。
The raised platform made the speaker easy to see.
升高的講台讓講者很容易被看到。
Run your fingers over the raised letters on the sign.
用手指摸摸標誌上凸起的字母。
The driver made a tricky manoeuvre to park in the small space.
駕駛員做了一個巧妙的動作，把車停進狹小的空位。
The army carried out a training manoeuvre in the hills.
軍隊在山區進行了一次演習。
It was hard to manoeuvre the sofa through the narrow door.
要把沙發從窄門搬進去很不容易。
She manoeuvred her bike between the parked cars.
她騎著腳踏車穿梭在停靠的汽車之間。
The situation looked hopeless, but they didn't give up.
情況看來絕望，但他們沒有放棄。
She felt hopeless after failing the exam three times.
考試連續三次沒過，她覺得很絕望。
I'm hopeless at cooking; I burn everything.
我很不會做菜，什麼都會燒焦。
He is hopeless with directions and always gets lost.
他完全沒有方向感，老是迷路。
An elk stood quietly at the edge of the forest.
一頭麋鹿靜靜地站在森林邊緣。
We saw a herd of elk while hiking in the mountains.
我們在山上健行時看到一群麋鹿。
The aeroplane landed smoothly despite the strong wind.
儘管風很大，飛機還是平穩降落了。
My little brother loves making paper aeroplanes.
我弟弟很愛摺紙飛機。
We had a Brazilian coffee at the corner cafe.
我們在轉角的咖啡館喝了一杯巴西咖啡。
The Brazilian team plays very fast football.
巴西隊踢的足球節奏很快。
My roommate is a Brazilian who loves music.
我的室友是個熱愛音樂的巴西人。
Many Brazilians speak Portuguese.
許多巴西人說葡萄牙語。
The remnants of the old wall are still visible.
舊城牆的殘跡至今仍看得見。
She used a remnant of blue cloth to make a bag.
她用一塊剩下的藍布做了一個袋子。
Remnant pieces of fabric are sold at half price.
零碎的剩餘布料半價出售。
A remnant population of wolves lives in the park.
公園裡還殘存著一小群狼。
Many people feel it is morally wrong to cheat.
許多人認為作弊在道德上是不對的。
She acted morally by returning the lost wallet.
她歸還遺失的錢包，行為合乎道德。
The child can recite the whole poem from memory.
那個孩子能憑記憶背出整首詩。
Students had to recite a short speech in front of the class.
學生必須在全班面前背誦一段短講稿。
We gave away our unwanted clothes to charity.
我們把不要的衣服捐給慈善機構。
This program blocks unwanted emails.
這個程式會擋掉不想要的電子郵件。
The apartment has a communal garden for all residents.
這棟公寓有一座所有住戶共用的花園。
Students share a communal kitchen on each floor.
學生們共用每層樓的公共廚房。
The festival strengthens communal ties in the village.
這個節慶加強了村裡的社區情感。
Communal dining is a tradition in many cultures.
集體用餐是許多文化的傳統。
The hotel's service was unsatisfactory.
這家旅館的服務令人不滿意。
His answer was unsatisfactory, so we asked again.
他的回答不能令人滿意，所以我們又問了一次。
Honesty is the guiding principle of our company.
誠實是我們公司的指導原則。
She was my guiding light when I was young.
她是我年輕時的明燈。
The guide is guiding the group through the old town.
導遊正帶領這群人走過老城區。
He's guiding his little sister across the busy road.
他正牽著妹妹過馬路。
Einstein was a great thinker of the twentieth century.
愛因斯坦是二十世紀的偉大思想家。
She is a deep thinker who always asks hard questions.
她是個善於深思的人，總是提出難題。
The company is expanding into new markets.
這家公司正把業務擴展到新市場。
The balloon keeps expanding as we blow into it.
我們一直吹氣，氣球就不斷膨脹。
The two brothers wrestled on the grass.
兄弟倆在草地上摔角。
He wrestled with the heavy door until it opened.
他使勁拉扯那扇沉重的門，直到它打開。
She has been wrestling with a tough decision all week.
她整個星期都在苦思一個艱難的決定。
Students wrestle with this math problem for hours.
學生為了這道數學題奮鬥了好幾個小時。
He is a dedicated nurse who works long hours.
他是一位長時間工作、盡心盡力的護理師。
The team is dedicated to making the best product.
這個團隊致力於做出最好的產品。
The lab has a dedicated room for testing.
這間實驗室有一個專用的測試室。
You can buy a dedicated charger for this camera.
你可以買這台相機專用的充電器。

dedicated.zh: 奉獻、獻給（過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She dedicated her life to helping children.
她將一生奉獻給幫助兒童。
The author dedicated the book to her parents.
作者把這本書獻給她的父母。
The advent of the internet changed how we shop.
網路的出現改變了我們購物的方式。
With the advent of spring, the park filled with people.
隨著春天的來臨，公園裡擠滿了人。
I use my phone to navigate in a new city.
我在陌生的城市用手機導航。
It was easy to navigate with such a clear map.
有這麼清楚的地圖，找路很容易。
The website is simple to navigate.
這個網站很容易瀏覽操作。
Older users sometimes struggle to navigate new apps.
年紀較大的使用者有時難以操作新的應用程式。
She learned to navigate difficult conversations at work.
她學會在職場上應對棘手的談話。
The family navigated the crisis together.
這一家人一起度過了危機。
He undid his seatbelt after the plane landed.
飛機降落後，他解開了安全帶。
Can you help me undo this knot?
你可以幫我解開這個結嗎？
Press this key to undo your last change.
按這個鍵可以取消你上一次的修改。
Nothing can undo the harm that was done.
已造成的傷害無法挽回。
I'm sceptical about claims that sound too good to be true.
對聽起來好得不像真的說法，我抱持懷疑。
The scientists were sceptical of the results.
科學家對這些結果存疑。
It was a collaborative project between two schools.
這是兩所學校合作的專案。
Our team prefers a collaborative way of working.
我們團隊偏好協作的工作方式。
Driving in this storm is sheer madness.
在這場暴風雨中開車簡直是瘋了。
The shop was full of holiday madness on Christmas Eve.
聖誕夜那天，店裡一片瘋狂的節慶混亂。
We stopped at an ice cream parlor after the movie.
看完電影後，我們到一間冰淇淋店坐坐。
She works at a beauty parlor downtown.
她在市區的一間美容院工作。
The little girl ran to her mama and hugged her.
小女孩跑向她的媽媽，抱住了她。
Mama made us soup when we were sick.
我們生病時，媽媽煮湯給我們喝。
They live in a small town in the northwestern part of the country.
他們住在國家西北部的一個小鎮。
A northwestern wind brought cold air to the city.
西北風為這座城市帶來冷空氣。
There was a big fuss when the flight was cancelled.
班機被取消時引起一陣騷動。
Don't make a fuss; it's only a small scratch.
別大驚小怪，只是一點小擦傷而已。
Stop fussing over the details and relax.
別再為細節瞎操心，放輕鬆吧。
The baby fussed all night because of his sore tooth.
小寶寶因為牙痛，整晚都在鬧。
I am accustomed to waking up early.
我習慣早起。
It took a while to get accustomed to the cold weather.
花了一段時間才習慣這種寒冷的天氣。

recorded.zh: 錄製、記錄（過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The band recorded their new song in a small studio.
樂團在一間小錄音室錄製了新歌。
She recorded her expenses in a notebook.
她把支出記在筆記本上。
We listened to a recorded message from the manager.
我們聽了經理的錄音留言。
It was the hottest day in recorded history.
那是有紀錄以來最熱的一天。
The cherry tree was covered in pink blossoms.
櫻花樹上開滿了粉紅色的花。
The garden is in full blossom this week.
這個星期花園裡的花正盛開。
The plum trees blossom in early spring.
梅樹在初春開花。
She blossomed into a confident young woman.
她逐漸成長為一位有自信的年輕女性。
The smiling waiter welcomed us to the restaurant.
面帶微笑的服務生歡迎我們來到餐廳。
She had a smiling face in every photo.
她在每張照片裡都笑容滿面。
His answer was ambiguous, so we weren't sure what he meant.
他的回答模稜兩可，我們不確定他的意思。
The ambiguous sign confused many drivers.
那個意思不明的標誌讓許多駕駛人搞不清楚。
The spacecraft will land on the moon next year.
這艘太空船明年將登陸月球。
Engineers tested the spacecraft before the launch.
工程師在發射前測試了這艘太空船。
The king imprisoned his enemies in a tower.
國王把他的敵人關在塔裡。
People who break this law can be imprisoned for years.
違反這項法律的人可能被監禁多年。
She trained for six months to run her first marathon.
她訓練了六個月，準備跑人生第一場馬拉松。
The marathon is about forty-two kilometers long.
馬拉松全程大約四十二公里。
The meeting turned into a four-hour marathon.
那場會議變成長達四小時的馬拉松。
Studying for the exam felt like a marathon.
準備這場考試感覺像一場耐力賽。
